# The QUADPACK node tables as netlib writes them, verbatim, out of the DATA statements.

# QUADPACK is public domain. Source: quadpack/dqng.f, dqk15.f, dqk21.f, dqk31.f, dqk41.f, dqk51.f
# and dqk61.f, fetched from netlib for this file. Each line is one DATA statement copied out of the
# named source, blanks and all, because the digits of a constant are split across the columns of
# the original and a reader that only takes the first group gets a different number.
#
# tests/backports/host/quadrature/tables.py reads this file, prints the C tables of
# packages/a/apple-backports/Accelerate/Quadrature10.m from it, and with --check compares them
# against what that file holds. The lines are what the port's numbers have to equal.
